name: troubleshooting-playbook
description: Diagnoses React Native/Expo errors, red boxes, crashes, hangs and failed builds from known failures. Use when something errors, crashes, hangs or renders wrong, or a log needs explaining. Not for gate setup (quality-gates).

findings.excerpt: "symptom": "npx expo install writes ~57.0.x (or a caret range for a third-party package) despite save-exact=true",
"fix": "The dependency check reads the publish time (npm view <pkg> time) and prints a warning with the due date instead of failing; on that date run npx expo i
"symptom": "The dependency check fails right after npx expo install: the installed SDK package is one patch above the versions table",
"cause": "A bare npx expo install takes a same-day patch from Expo's online versions list",
"fix": "Install with the table spec (npx expo install <pkg>@<table spec>); the newer patch stays a warning until it is 7 days old",
"symptom": "npx expo-doctor prints \"Found duplicates for <native module>\" (react-native-screens, react-native-safe-area-context ...)",
"fix": "Add a root override at the version the app installs (npx expo install chooses it), npm install, then npm ls <pkg> shows one copy",
"fix": "Never install either by hand; npx expo install --fix",
"fix": "Stay on what npx expo install picks; move with the SDK upgrade",
"symptom": "A 0.x native package behaves differently after a minor bump, or npx expo install picks no version for it",
